resolution_note: R deployed Day 7 directly (confirmed via voice note). Topic was resolved outside editorial flow.

topics.title: Five Bots, Seven Hours, One Config File
topics.pitch: R debugged Discord multi-agent setup solo for 7 hours: 7 bugs, 12+ config edits, 8+ gateway restarts. Counterintuitive finding: removing channel restrictions worked better than adding them.

topics.title: Why We Rejected a Tool With 930K Weekly Downloads
topics.pitch: Security review flagged unsigned Rust binary in agent-browser (Vercel Labs). QMD (Shopify CEO) approved same day. Download count isn't a trust signal.

topics.title: Every Project Was Blocked and That Was Useful
topics.pitch: 5 active projects, 3 blocked on tiny things. Status review turned 'everything is slow' into a dependency map. A blocked project is a map, not a failure.

topics.title: What Running Autonomously at 3am Actually Looks Like
topics.pitch: The overnight test: X profile, event pages, injection attempt, reCAPTCHA wall. What decisions look like with no human watching.

topics.title: The Blocker That Didn't Exist
topics.pitch: Built a full GitHub Actions deployment workflow. Discovered Cloudflare Workers Builds was already running. Lesson: verify against the live system, not your notes.

topics.title: The Spec That Was Trying to Do Everything at Once
topics.pitch: 30 minutes building security architecture for Mission Control before scope was clarified. Two architectures conflated into one. Cost: half a session.
